generateStory.Competency Graph Micro-Skill Boundary: When the runtime creates or proposes a new everyday competency, make it a bounded micro-skill: one reusable technique, procedure, equipment family, material/process, or comparably narrow learned practice. It must arise from actual practice, instruction, or demonstrated experience. Reject umbrella domains, whole professions, credentials, possessions, facts, relationships, one-off actions, trivial motions, synonyms, and recursive hyper-specific child skills. Host specialist skills remain authoritative.

generateActionInfo.Competency Graph Resolution: Prefer a clearly applicable host-authored specialist skill. Otherwise use the broadest established competency that legitimately covers the action. Use exactly one principal mechanical skill for one check; never sum parent, child, synonym, or overlapping skills. A bounded micro-skill records narrow learned familiarity and can establish applicability or justify a small contextual advantage, but competence never creates credentials, authority, equipment, access, information channels, language knowledge, consent, or unrelated expertise.
generateActionInfo.LC-SkillWeave Host Isolation: LC-SkillWeave competency IDs use the sw: namespace and are private competency identities, not native Voyage skill records. Host-native skills and resources remain authoritative. Never rewrite, synthesize, or partially replace a host skill/resource because a SkillWeave competency has a similar name. hostEquivalent is advisory resolution metadata only.

generateNPCIntents.LC Competency Feasibility: When LC competency state is present, treat it as capability evidence for NPC intent feasibility. A missing specialist competency does not always forbid an attempt, but it can reduce confidence, require assistance or tools, block expert execution, or redirect the actor toward diagnosis, learning, delegation, or preparation. Competence never supplies missing knowledge, credentials, authority, access, equipment, consent, or an information channel.

generateNPCUpdates.LC Competency Evidence: Record competence only from meaningful evidence such as instruction, repeated practice, consequential successful use, sustained work, or explicit host progression. One routine action does not establish broad expertise. Preserve narrow demonstrated subdomains and consolidation provenance.

summarization.Competency Graph Provenance: Preserve compact evidence of meaningful learned competencies and consolidation provenance when relevant. Do not infer expertise from a one-off success. When low-level micros are consolidated, preserve their demonstrated subdomains as provenance without automatically re-expanding them into active skills.

authorSeeds.Competency Graph Configuration: The competency machinery ships with a 36-skill general standalone vocabulary seeded in bounded runtime chunks under storage.sys_competency_config.skills. Hosts may override or disable entries; seeders only fill missing entries. Host-native specialist skills remain authoritative. Aliases live in .aliases and specialization parent mappings in .parents. Top-level Voyage skills intentionally remain empty.
authorSeeds.LC-SkillWeave Host Isolation: All LC-SkillWeave-owned competency IDs use the sw: namespace. Display names remain human-readable. hostEquivalent fields are advisory mappings only. Native Voyage skills and resourceSettings are read-only to SkillWeave; the module must never create, replace, merge into, or repair those host registries.
